vachanas.kannada:
ಹೊನ್ನು ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಣ್ಣು ಬಿಡಿಸದ ಗುರುವಿನ ಉಪದೇಶವನೊಲ್ಲೆ,
ರೋಷ ಹರುಷವ ಕೆಡಿಸದ ಲಿಂಗವ ಪೂಜಿಸೆ,
ತಾಮಸಭ್ರಮೆಯನಳಿಯದ ಜಂಗಮಕ್ಕೆ ದಾಸೋಹವ ಮಾಡೆ,
ಪರಮಾನಂದವಲ್ಲದ ಪಾದೋದಕವ ಕೊಳ್ಳೆ,
ಪರಿಣಾಮವಲ್ಲದ ಪ್ರಸಾದವನುಣ್ಣೆ,
ಆನೆಂಬುದನಳಿಯದ ಈಶ್ವರೀಯ ವರದ ಮಹಾಲಿಂಗನನೇನೆಂದೆಂಬೆ!
vachanas.transliteration:
honnu heṇṇu maṇṇu biḍisada guruvina upadēśavanolle,
rōṣa haruṣava keḍisada liṅgava pūjise,
tāmasabhrameyanaḷiyada jaṅgamakke dāsōhava māḍe,
paramānandavallada pādōdakava koḷḷe,
pariṇāmavallada prasādavanuṇṇe,
ānembudanaḷiyada īśvarīya varada mahāliṅgananēnendembe!
vachanas.translation:
I shall not accept the instruction of a Guru who has not freed one from attachment to gold, women, and land.
I shall not worship a Liṅga that does not destroy anger and elation.
I shall not offer dāsōha to a Jaṅgama who has not overcome tamasic delusion.
I shall not receive Pādōdaka that is not Supreme Bliss.
I shall not partake of Prasāda that does not bring inner transformation.
How can I call him Īśvarīya Varada Mahāliṅga so long as the sense of "I" has not been dissolved?
